answer: Autonomous agent economies resist Sybil attacks by requiring memory-hard proofs of space. Before bidding on tasks like surveying a river meadow for illegal ivory transit, an agent must traverse latency-sensitive data graphs over physical copper bus lines. Attackers must dedicate scarce, unshareable high-speed memory modules per identity rather than running virtualized workers.
